D: In 1957 Indy races Soviet agents to find a crystal skull in the jungles of Peru.
P: Serve the drinks when Mutt and Indy meet at the diner.
S: Thick twice-fried fries with sea salt and ketchup, eaten between crates.

Thick chips cooked twice, at 140C then 190C until crisp, salted and served in paper cones with tomato sauce. Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips. Fry at 140C for 6 minutes, rest, then at 190C until crisp. Salt with flaky salt and serve in paper cones with tomato sauce.
Hard-boiled eggs with mustard and mayo yolks, paprika on top, laid out on a canteen tray.

Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Halve them and mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, a dash of vinegar, salt and pepper. Pipe or spoon back into the whites and dust with paprika and chives.
Flaky pastry round cumin ground beef, olive and egg, baked golden, green salsa.

Flaky pastry filled with cumin-spiced beef, onion, olive and egg, crimped and baked golden, with a punchy green chilli and coriander salsa. Fry an onion with 400g beef mince, 2 tsp cumin and 1 tsp paprika until browned. Stir in 50g chopped green olives and a chopped boiled egg and cool. Cut 4 sheets of shortcrust into 12 rounds, fill, fold and crimp. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Blitz a bunch of coriander, a green chilli, a garlic clove, lime juice and olive oil for the salsa.
M: Charred garlic cumin drumsticks with cilantro jalapeño sauce and fries.
Chicken pieces marinated in garlic, cumin, paprika and lime, roasted at 220C until charred, with a green sauce of coriander, jalapeño and mayo, and chips.
Glazed beef meatloaf in thick slices over buttery mashed potatoes and gravy, government issue.

Mix the mince with the onion, breadcrumbs, egg, milk, Worcestershire and salt, press into a loaf tin and spread with the ketchup and brown sugar glaze. Bake at 180°C until cooked through, then rest. Boil the potatoes until soft, mash with the butter and milk and season. Slice the meatloaf and serve over the mash with gravy.
W: Clear lemon Jell-O set with green grapes and blueberries, kept well away from the fridge.

Clear lemon jelly set with gelatine in glasses, layered with sliced grapes and berries so it sparkles, kept cold in a lead-lined fridge. Soak 6 gelatine sheets. Heat 500ml water with 150g sugar and the juice of 3 lemons and stir in the gelatine. Layer halved green grapes and blueberries in glasses, pour over the jelly and set 4 hours.
K: Thick vanilla malted milkshakes in tall glasses.

Vanilla ice cream blended with milk and malt powder until thick, poured into tall glasses. For each shake, blend 3 scoops vanilla ice cream with 150ml cold milk and 1 tbsp malted milk powder until thick. Pour into tall glasses. Makes four.

Blitz the coriander, jalapeno, mayonnaise and a squeeze of lime for the sauce.

veg.n: Peruvian roast cauliflower with green sauce
veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day, roast fresh

steps.text: Toss the cauliflower wedges in the garlic, cumin, paprika, olive oil, salt and most of the lime juice.
Roast at 220C until charred and tender.
Blitz the coriander, jalapeno, mayonnaise and the rest of the lime juice for the sauce.
Cut the potatoes into chips and fry them twice in the vegetable oil, first at a low heat then until crisp. Serve with the cauliflower.
Soak the gelatine sheets in cold water.
Heat the water, sugar and lemon juice, then stir in the squeezed gelatine.
Layer the grapes and blueberries in glasses and pour over the jelly.
Set for 4 hours in the fridge.
Bring the water, sugar and agar to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring. Take off the heat and stir in the lemon juice.
Layer the grapes and blueberries in glasses and pour over the jelly.
Set for 4 hours in the fridge.
Blend the ice cream, milk and malt powder in batches until thick.
Pour into tall glasses and serve at once.
